\begin{frame}{Complex TikZ Diagrams}
  \begin{center}
    \begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=2cm, auto, >=latex']
      \node [rectangle, draw, fill=blue!20, text width=5em, text centered, rounded corners] (init) {Initialize};
      \node [diamond, draw, fill=green!20, text width=4.5em, text badly centered, below of=init] (identify) {Check State};
      \node [block, right of=identify, node distance=3cm] (update) {Update Cache};

      \draw [->] (init) -- (identify);
      \draw [->] (identify) -- node {yes} (update);
      \draw [->] (update) |- (init);
    \end{tikzpicture}
  \end{center}
\end{frame}
